name: side crunch with hands on chest
description: A side-lying crunch with the arms crossed over the chest. It works the obliques along the side of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your core and lift your shoulders and legs toward each other.
Crunch sideways, squeezing the side of your waist.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled, without pulling on your neck.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
